Interactions & their partial dependencies

Code 
data <- 
  readRDS(
    here::here("Data/output/B_models/",
               "B_01_list_all_results_rf.rds"))

fit_2 <- 
  data$res[[2]] %>% 
  extract_fit_parsnip()

train <- 
  data$list_split_data[[2]]$train

pdp_lnR_interactions <- 
  list()

Code 
pdp_lnR_interactions[[1]] <-
